description:
Introducing the all new Vertex DJ frame by Verde. Dreamt, drawn, prototyped, tested, perfected, and true. Crafted with 6061 aluminum tubing with internal cable routing. Custom made seat tube with wider stance to stiffen the bottom bracket. Asymmetrical BB yoke to allow sprocket clearance and shorter chain stays. Streamlined seat stays that taper to CNC machined micro dropouts. Vertex by definition means the highest point. Parks, pump tracks, or dirt. Take this frame to new heights.

Details

6061 series aluminum construction

CNC machined 1.5” tapered head tube

Sealed internal, Zero Stack 44/56, 1-1/8” to 1-1/2” tapered headset included

Internal rear brake cable routing

Custom made seat tube

Asymmetrical BB yoke

Euro bottom bracket shell

SRAM DUB BSA 73mm bottom bracket included
